name: rufa-elan
description: RUFA ELAN E-commerce Platform - MERN Stack

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.format: cd frontend && npm run format && cd ../backend && npm run format
scripts.test: cd frontend && npm run test && cd ../backend && npm run test
scripts.clean: rimraf frontend/.next frontend/node_modules backend/dist backend/node_modules node_modules
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run install:all
